name: Juwairen Juneiren
source:
Klett Bailey (※ The name can be changed) as a noble lady appeared in the laboratory and was informed that she had participated in a memory deletion program.

However, she didn't feel that her memory was lacking in any way.

The laboratory assistant told her that these were the "sad memories that she had erased on her own 10 hours ago", so there was no need to retrieve them.

What puzzled her was that among the list of memories she 'requested' to be deleted, there were names that she was completely unfamiliar with...
